settings.text: Does the UV light really kill 99.9% of germs?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Yes, the UV-C light our devices use is c
settings.text: Yes, the UV-C light our devices use is clinically proven to disinfect 99.9% of surface bacteria.

settings.repere: Texte · How long does it take for the brush head
settings.text: How long does it take for the brush head to dry in the base?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Please make sure the base is plugged in
settings.text: Please make sure the base is plugged in at all times and the brush is seated properly, shaking off any excess moisture before putting it back into the base. The drying time of the brush will take 2-6 hours.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · The UMMA handle is equipped with a long-
settings.text: The UMMA handle is equipped with a long-life rechargeable battery that can last 2-3 weeks between charges when brushing twice a day.
